title: Multiplication Fill the Gaps exercise
description: Fill the Gaps exercise about Multiplication
fill_template: Multiplication is one of the four fundamental operations in arithmetic. It is a quick way to represent the sum of equal numbers. The result of a multiplication is called the product, while the two multiplied numbers are called factors. The multiplication symbol is often represented by a cross or an asterisk. The operation has several algebraic properties, including commutativity, associativity, distributivity, and the existence of an identity element and a zero element. The definition of multiplication can be extended to natural, rational, real, and complex numbers. There are various methods to perform multiplication, including manual methods, mechanical methods, and electronic methods. The concept of multiplication is widely used in mathematics, science, and everyday life.
